scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-conditional-blocks wp i18n make-pot . languages/od-conditional-blocks.pot --domain=od-conditional-blocks --exclude=vendor,node_modules,dist,tests
scripts.i18n:mo: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-conditional-blocks wp i18n make-mo languages
scripts.format: wp-scripts format src tests/js tests/e2e playwright.config.js vitest.config.mjs
scripts.test:php: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-conditional-blocks php vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist
scripts.i18n:json: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-conditional-blocks wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge
